# hrui_trunk_group (Data Source)

Fetches information about a configured trunk group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hrui_trunk_group" "example" {
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The trunk group ID to query.

### Read-Only

- `ports` (List of Number) List of ports in the trunk group (1-indexed).
- `type` (String) Type of the trunk group ('static' or 'LACP').
